Shuffle backward 103 centimeters while the scoop drops. Angle off to starboard to point at the seismometer. Reverse course so the rear bumper points at the ridge. End the loop with a 74 centimeter roll into the hangar.

Sprint 61 centimeters between the canyon walls. Dead end so turn the rover end for end. Retreat slowly 78 centimeters with the walls closing in. Make the final 56 centimeter dash toward the exit.

final.mission_log: Ease down off the ramp and hold a straight line for 7 centimeters. Pivot to the right so the solar panel catches the sunrise. Creep straight ahead another 38 centimeters to line up with the drill hole. Swap ends so the camera mast faces back down the trail. Give yourself 143 centimeters of room by backing off the rim. Haul around to the left and hold there until the telemetry catches up. Finish the run with 64 centimeters straight ahead to the charging pad.
